_comment: config:lists example — upload via: wrangler kv key put --binding=TODO_CACHE --remote 'config:lists' "$(cat config-examples/lists.json)"
_comment2: Replace <placeholders> with your own list-name fragments. Patterns are JS RegExp source strings matched case-insensitively (flag 'i') against display names after emoji are stripped. First match wins; unmatched lists are 'unclassified'.

patterns._comment: --- todo: lists you actively work from ---
--- reference: idea buckets / collections you don't actively work from ---
--- excluded: shared or archived lists you want kept out of queries ---
The 'Flagged Emails' well-known list is a common excluded example (Outlook auto-populates it).

_comment_aliases: aliases maps short handles -> Graph list IDs (get IDs from the list_lists tool). Do NOT put comment keys inside the aliases object — every key becomes a real alias.
_comment3: no_sync excludes lists from delta sync (by wellknownListName OR Graph list ID). They stay listed + on-demand readable but are not indexed. flaggedEmails is skipped by DEFAULT regardless of this list.
_comment4: sync_flagged_emails: set true to index the (usually huge) flaggedEmails well-known list. Off by default to conserve the daily rows-written budget and keep full-text search clean.
